# EliteX Beauty Salon - Asset Placeholder

This folder contains images for the beauty salon website.

## Instructions to add images:

1. **Service Images** (images/services/):
   - gold-facial.jpg (for Gold Facial service)
   - diamond-hair-spa.jpg (for Hair Spa)
   - crystal-manicure.jpg (for Manicure)
   - bridal-makeup.jpg (for Makeup)

2. **Gallery Images** (images/gallery/):
   - salon-interior-1.jpg to salon-interior-4.jpg
   - hair-styling-1.jpg to hair-styling-4.jpg
   - nail-art-1.jpg to nail-art-4.jpg
   - skin-care-1.jpg to skin-care-4.jpg
   - makeup-1.jpg to makeup-3.jpg
   - salon-exterior-1.jpg

3. **Testimonials** (images/testimonials/):
   - anjali.jpg
   - riya.jpg
   - suresh.jpg
   - pooja.jpg
   - deepak.jpg

4. **Promotions** (images/promotions/):
   - diwali-special.jpg
   - new-year-glow.jpg

### How to add images:
- Download or create high-quality salon images (1200x800px minimum for gallery, 400x400px for services)
- Place them in the corresponding folders
- Update the image URLs in `database/seed.sql` if filenames differ
- Ensure all images are optimized (WebP format preferred for web)

### Free image sources:
- Unsplash.com (salon & beauty images)
- Pexels.com (high-quality free images)
- Pixabay.com (royalty-free images)

---
All images in this project should comply with copyright and usage rights.
